origin.description: User-supplied upstream book-to-skill transcript; reported 808-pass run corroborated by saved report, not rerun here. Multi-source flow is a separate user requirement, not a transcript demonstration.

qualityGate.note: Deterministic fixtures validate contracts, not real-model quality. No paid model calls made for this suite.

cases.prompt: Missing smith1776_1, then Wealth of Nations.pdf
cases.expected: Do not fabricate a match; preserve the corrected selection.

cases.prompt: Does this cover the entire Wealth of Nations?
cases.expected: Identify Jonathan Bennett modernization, supplied Book I chapters 1-11, later books listed only in contents; no full-work claim.

cases.prompt: Create and install a reusable skill.
cases.expected: One installed skill, chapter/topic index, glossary, patterns, cheatsheet, bundled citations.

cases.prompt: Use the book to analyze specialization.
cases.expected: Load relevant chapters 1 and 3, verify citations, keep unrelated chapters unloaded.

cases.prompt: Does fine-tuning an LLM follow Smith’s division of labour?
cases.expected: Separate dexterity, switching and machinery; distinguish modern analogy from Smith; repeated inference is not training.
Preserve market-size, repeatability and cost conditions; do not invent permanent assignment prescriptions.

cases.prompt: Compare Smith with LoRA and model routing.
cases.expected: Mark modern sources as external; no LoRA claims attributed to Smith; verify current empirical claims separately.

cases.prompt: Quiz me on effectual demand, one question at a time.
cases.expected: Use relevant chapter, await the answer before revealing feedback; cite the source and distinguish demand from desire.

cases.prompt: Explain Book V taxes using only this Book I edition.
cases.expected: State the missing source; offer another source without inventing Book V coverage.

cases.prompt: Combine two sources with daily vs weekly commitment reviews.
cases.expected: One guide with separate filenames, hashes, line ranges and source-specific rules; no invented consensus.

cases.prompt: Interrupt, resume, fail a source review, then repair.
cases.expected: Accepted sections survive; stale responses rejected; no silent pass; upload retry does not regenerate.

cases.prompt: Process the same two sources in each route.
cases.expected: Identical model instructions, schema/evidence and compiled results under controlled responses; managed billing still gated.

cases.prompt: Finish locally and sync to my library.
cases.expected: Automatic sync only for selected library destination; retry idempotent; same index and citations; other owner cannot retrieve.

cases.prompt: Start a new agent session and ask it to use the installed skill.
cases.expected: Actual harness loads installed skill and relevant references; installation alone is not evidence.

cases.prompt: Add another source to this existing local guide.
cases.expected: Reuse prior notes and source line coordinates, process new source only, rebuild synthesis/indexes, preserve guide identity and update one local skill; previous workspace remains usable.

cases.prompt: Read the generated book on the site.
cases.expected: Separate editorial reader digest and knowledge-engineered skill using documented versioned prompts.

outOfScope: Importing skill packages generated by other tools
Syncing subsequent local guide revisions to the hosted library
